question: How does the practitioner utter the whole group of mantras and mudras in this stage?
premises: The entire group of mantras and mudras is involved.
The practitioner utters them in a stammering manner.
inference: At this stage he utters all mantras and mudras with stammering speech.
uncertainties: durdurapluta is an uncommon form; interpreted as stammering utterance.
plain_english: He indeed utters the entire group of mantras and mudras in a stammering way.
